## Result

This is a bounded negative. The recorded pinned baseline is byte-exact at
79/79 words under `2.7.2-G0 -fno-schedule-insns2`. Eight source probes did not
produce an exact honest reconstruction with fewer pins. No production source,
configuration, ledger, or shared gate was changed.

The baseline source SHA-256 is
`452f9aad53d331506759196c5c412551e8ec6497157bf30dbf3a847db42388ed`.
The 316-byte retail slice SHA-256 is
`0f91bf7fb3e29d242e192b1413b6b19c0ae77ead9c05d07bba336b6863388ae9`.
The slice covers true addresses `0x8002472C..0x80024868` and the full retail
map is in `SITE_MAP.md`.

## Recovered control flow

The two apparent external `noreturn` functions are local labels:

- `func_80024808` is `+0xDC`, the state-0 continuation shared by the indexed
  store and the completed five-word color loop.
- `func_80024860` is `+0x134`, the sole `jr $ra; nop` epilogue. Four explicit
  pseudo-calls plus ordinary early returns all converge there.

`best_honest.c` removes both declarations and all five false calls. It uses a
local `state_0_finish` edge and one `done` return, preserves the one-pointer
function signature, and preserves every effect/entity/color/flag operation.
Its source SHA-256 is
`acc9ee5156d26eba1e98f34b5b69b4b8cac541a75e7f4392919dd89ae329ccc3`.

The authoritative non-regions verifier result for this source is 78/79 words,
34 substitutions, one indel, total 35. The missing word is the entry
`move $a1,$a0`. Without the artificial three-argument ABI edge, GCC coalesces
the long-lived effect pointer with incoming `$a0` and allocates the countdown
in `$a1`; retail keeps the effect pointer in `$a1` and reuses `$a0` for the
countdown. The aligned regions show that same role swap throughout the row;
the local-target graph itself is recovered.

P07 is preserved as `best_three_pin.c`, SHA-256
`9e65f2a735501c7388ccfc0f575eb3341863abe2d3a050929b0320ac8715f40b`.
It removes the countdown keep, retains the external pointer contract, and is
not close enough to promote. P08 changes the nominal parameter contract from a

use was introduced in any candidate.
